missing: A head-to-head of the actual 4-in-1 options (Mophie, AceFast Z9 Pro, Ugreen GaN Mini, Zens modular, Scosche) showing what the MacBook really gets when iPhone, Watch and AirPods are all drawing at once, with current prices and whether 60W is enough for a 14/16-inch Pro.
why: One major reviewer, Macworld, answers this with testing across three pages: a tested AceFast Z9 Pro review, a tested Mophie 4-in-1 review, and a MagSafe roundup with a 4-in-1 pick; WIRED's tested roundup only touches 4-in-1 in passing. But none is a dedicated comparison of MacBook-capable stations, and the rest are off-target charger guides, a retailer page and recycled Amazon spam. A focused comparison page could get in, but it would be competing with Macworld's tested coverage rather than filling an empty field.
